column1: # proptable_overrides.tsv — solver-proven 0x03 wire shapes that differ from the
# native storage tag numbers in tools/proptable.tsv (server-0.742 vs traced
# client-2.739 version skew; see FINDINGS.md "Recv v3").
# Columns: prop_id wire_tag prefix_flag [fixed_len]
# wire_tag: value tag whose wire shape closes every live occurrence exactly
#   (negative controls: the native-number shape parses strictly fewer msgs).
# prefix_flag: Content/asset (33/61) prefix shape in 0x03 values (0 = plain
#   string shape [len][bytes]; 1 = prefix-compressed). Proven per prop below.
# fixed_len (optional 4th column): opaque fixed value length that OVERRIDES
#   the tag reader for framing (raw bytes carried). Only for base-shape +
#   fixed-trailer props proven by skeleton recurrence (identical structural
#   slots, varying values) + exact-close of full chains — never a bare
#   length guess. wire_tag stays informative (the base shape).
# alt_len (optional 5th column): LONG length for two-form props. The short
#   form (fixed_len) wins iff a valid triple header (03 + well-formed ref
#   + in-table prop) starts exactly at +short_len (peek, no consumption);
#   else the long form is read. Proven for 5033 (14B + triple-follows vs
#   20B + data: 447 repeating slots + exact multi-triple tiling).
# Brookhaven 4924922222 (2026-10-12, 9.5MB capture, tools/solve_proptags
# exact-close rounds; each won by strict pure-close majority, ties keep
# native — see FINDINGS "Recv v4"). Disjoint from the Crossroads set, so
# no cross-game contradiction; global table holds until one appears.
# Brookhaven 4924922222, second session (2026-10-13, 10.7MB capture, f78c
# snapshot magic, same 634/10268/6978 build as Crossroads new-build).
# tools/solve_proptags topN=60: pure 811 -> 3777. Bar >= 4 closes, no
# cross-game contradiction (248 stays 68: Brookhaven 39@3 is derail-victim
# noise vs Crossroads' unique proof; 10268 stays 25). All disjoint from
# the existing Crossroads + first-Brookhaven sets; global table holds.
# Brookhaven second session, extended shapes (2026-10-13, skeleton-proven):
# 5033 (native tag 9/u8) reads 14B opaque on the wire (frame#1980 fully
# tiles: [5033:14][5514:14][5133:15] repeating to exact frame end; the
# earlier 20B reading swallowed the following 5514 header (6B). 5514
# (native tag 22/12B) reads 14B opaque (476 identical per-tick slots).
# 6983 stays 20B (tag 39): 445 pure-with-20B vs 0 pure-with-1B settles it;
# the s31 stops under native-1B are the same misread. Gate:
# exact multi-triple tiling to frame end (see FINDINGS).
# Brookhaven second session, period/skeleton-proven (2026-10-13):
# 1520/1522/1524 read 13B on the wire (tag-65 shape; exact 21B/14B triple
# rhythm in a 329B fully-tiled chain; native 19/28/2). 5039 (native 55)
# reads 4B (same tiling; f32 tag 11). Gate: exact period + downstream
# triple validation (the greedy solver can't reach these: every occurrence
# co-occurs with other poisons, so no single-tag trial ever closes).
# 3839 (native tag 11/f32) reads 4B + fixed 13B block = 17B opaque
# (skeleton: 11 identical slots [...,3812,0x15,3839] then divergence into
# valid 03/07 type bytes at +13; s7f variant splits after).
